title: Run-id injection and output guarantee implemented
description: TraceContext and TraceEnvelope now carry a UUID v4 run_id. All four prompt-rendering paths inject {{run_id}}. check_run_outputs fallback writes stubs for any absent signals/metrics files in CLI mode.

title: Bootstrap run: run_id not present in initial prompt
description: This run was executed using the pre-feature binary (v1.3.2). The {{run_id}} token was not substituted in the initial prompt. Post-feature runs (v1.4.0+) will have a UUID injected via Session context.
